sourceAuthority: Scavenger's Guide to Droids (rendered PDF printed pp.88-97; OCR is index only)

records.name: Duelist Elite Training Droid
issues: Sith Weapon Master programming reverts after shutdown/restart
Stiletto hidden weapon triggers only after covert signal, flat-footed first hit
Lightsaber Sparring Partner exchanges proficiency rather than granting bonus feat
Rapier and First Aid resource/action validity must be mapped to weapon/medical authority

records.name: E522 Assassin Droid
issues: Hunter-seeker missile locks until hit or five consecutive missed rounds; six missiles total
Needler neurotoxin applies to living creature after successful hit, Core poison authority required
Heavy support variant relocates launcher to shoulders and replaces needler and ion rifle
Fire-linked twin blaster is one standard-action firing choice with -2, not twice-unrestricted attacks

records.name: EI-9 Network Security Droid
issues: Electromagnetic Pulse 6-square radius, 1d10+BAB vs Fortitude, one-round effect and one-round recharge; external electronic-target authority needed
Slicer Tracker tracking program and remote sensor permission require distinct systems and Use Computer checks
Hidden core restoration attempts after 1d12 minutes, repeats once per hour after failures
Heroic service chassis must purchase droid port/processor/appendages and does not inherit printed heroic talents

records.name: EV-Series Supervisor Droid
issues: Bully printed main prose rerolls its own Persuasion; protocol grants master +2 circumstance Persuasion; unresolved controlling rule
Quartermaster requires per-item 8 hours maintenance within 24 hours, first attack or skill check only each encounter
Technician swaps internal comlink for diagnostics package, head targeting scope is repair-specific +2 equipment
Heroic protocol chassis gains heuristic plus Bully in lieu of translator, not alongside it

records.name: FLTCH-Series Battle Droid
issues: Nightmare main free action Intimidation vs protocol two swift actions once/encounter
Zero-Range main automatic follow-up vs protocol two swift actions once/encounter; grapple/rifle attacks require verified V2 weapon mount rights
Built-in missile launcher has exactly one missile, no infinite ammunition; ordinary weapon grip may incur -5
Ammo Boost costs 500 credits on droid +100 on weapon, requires two DC20 Mechanics checks/two hours and double power units for optional +1d6

validation.pdfPageReview: Ten pp.88–97 PDF pages rendered and visually reviewed

nonInflationPolicy: Printed source facts and schema correctness are not complete source-mechanical certification. Printed attack expressions remain source-only.
